questions.question: A person is exposed to an intense, high-pitched sound. The acoustic reflex is activated. Which action of the tensor tympani muscle helps protect the auditory apparatus?
options: It relaxes the tympanic membrane to increase vibration
It tenses the tympanic membrane to reduce vigorous vibration
It opens the round window to increase perilymph movement
It relaxes the stapes to increase its inward displacement
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. It tenses the tympanic membrane to reduce vigorous vibration

questions.question: A healthy passenger repeatedly swallows during an airplane journey to maintain normal hearing. What is the main purpose of this action?
options: To equalize pressure across the tympanic membrane
To increase endolymph production within the cochlea
To stimulate the hair cells directly in the cochlea
To increase the tension of the basilar membrane
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. To equalize pressure across the tympanic membrane

questions.question: A patient tilts their head to the right while maintaining an upright posture. Which change occurs in the discharge of the otolith organs?
options: Increased right utricular discharge and decreased left utricular discharge
Decreased right utricular discharge and increased left utricular discharge
Increased discharge from both utricles equally
Decreased discharge from both utricles equally
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Increased right utricular discharge and decreased left utricular discharge

questions.question: A patient is examined for vestibular function. Which structure detects angular acceleration?
options: Macula
Semicircular canals
Cochlea
Otolith membrane

questions.question: A hair cell is stimulated by bending its stereocilia. Which direction causes depolarization?
options: Away from the kinocilium
Toward the kinocilium
Perpendicular to the kinocilium
Toward the cochlea
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Toward the kinocilium

questions.question: A person is rotating at a constant speed. What happens to the sensation of rotation after some time?
options: It continuously increases
It changes into hearing sensation
It disappears
It becomes stronger after 20 seconds

questions.question: A person suddenly stops rotating. Which sensation is expected?
options: Rotation in the same direction
Counter-rotation
Complete loss of balance without vertigo
Hearing loss

questions.question: After rotation stops, persistent endolymph movement produces which clinical effect?
options: Vertigo
Deafness
Tremor
Spastic gait

questions.question: A patient experiences forward acceleration in a vehicle. The otoconia lag backward because of their inertia, bending the hair-cell cilia. Which sensation may result?
options: A false sensation of falling forward
A false sensation of falling backward
A false sensation of rotating upward
A false sensation of rotating downward
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. A false sensation of falling backward

questions.question: A histological specimen shows auditory receptor cells positioned on a membrane within the cochlea. Which membrane supports the organ of Corti?
options: The tectorial membrane
The basilar membrane
Reissner's membrane
The secondary tympanic membrane
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. The basilar membrane

questions.question: A patient has impaired function of the structure that normally closes the terminal opening of the scala tympani. Which structure is involved?
options: The stapes footplate
The tympanic membrane
The secondary tympanic membrane
Reticular lamina
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C. The secondary tympanic membrane

questions.question: During exposure to a loud sound, the stapedius muscle contracts. Which effect is associated with this contraction according to the notes?
options: Increased inward displacement of the stapes
Increased vibration of the tympanic membrane
Prevention of inward displacement of the stapes
Increased movement of the round window
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C. Prevention of inward displacement of the stapes

questions.question: A traveler experiences ear discomfort during an airplane's descent. Which mechanism normally helps prevent excessive pressure differences across the tympanic membrane?
options: Contraction of the outer hair cells
Opening of the Eustachian tube
Movement of the tectorial membrane
Contraction of the spiral ganglion neurons
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Opening of the Eustachian tube

questions.question: A patient has dysfunction of the tensor tympani muscle. Which normal action of this muscle is directly impaired?
options: Pulling the malleus handle inward to maintain tympanic membrane tension
Pulling the stapes outward to increase movement at the round window
Moving the basilar membrane to stimulate the auditory hair cells
Opening the Eustachian tube to renew air in the middle ear
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Pulling the malleus handle inward to maintain tympanic membrane tension

questions.question: A person is exposed to an intense, high-pitched sound. The acoustic reflex is activated. Which action of the tensor tympani muscle helps protect the auditory apparatus?
options: It relaxes the tympanic membrane to increase vibration
It tenses the tympanic membrane to reduce vigorous vibration
It opens the round window to increase perilymph movement
It relaxes the stapes to increase its inward displacement
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. It tenses the tympanic membrane to reduce vigorous vibration

questions.question: A researcher studies the fluid environment of cochlear hair cells. The bases are bathed in one fluid, while the hair-cell processes are bathed in another. Which arrangement is correct?
options: Bases in endolymph; processes in perilymph
Bases in perilymph; processes in endolymph
Bases in cerebrospinal fluid; processes in perilymph
Bases in endolymph; processes in cerebrospinal fluid
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Bases in perilymph; processes in endolymph

questions.question: Regarding the hair cell in the cristae, what is their structure?
options: many small kinocilia and one large stiff stereocilium.
many small stereocilia and one large stiff kinocilium.
single stereocilium and single kinocilium
multiple stereocilia and multiple kinocilia
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. many small stereocilia and one large stiff kinocilium.
